hero.description: Your customers scan a QR code, leave a tip for the employee who served them, and rate their experience - all without downloading an app. You can see which team members stand out and what your customers have to say.

howItWorks.title: Three simple steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Easy for your customers. Valuable for your business and your team.

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.body: Customers scan the QR code displayed on a table, at the checkout, or on an employee's card. They can easily find the employee who served them and leave a tip.
scan.note: Printed QR cards are also available.

tip.title: Leave a tip
tip.body: Customers choose how much they want to tip and pay online. The tip goes directly to the selected employee or is shared across the team, depending on your settings.
tip.note: No app or customer account required.

feedback.title: Share their feedback
feedback.body: Customers rate their experience and can leave a short comment. All tips and reviews are collected in your dashboard, so you can see who received tips and what customers think about the service.
feedback.note: Meaningful feedback on your service, not just another review platform.

faq.title: Answers to <accent>your questions</accent>
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about tipping, customer feedback, and getting started with your team.

q1.question: How do customers leave a tip?
q1.answer: They scan the QR code, choose the amount they want, and pay online. There's no app to download or account to create.

q2.question: Can customers tip a specific employee?
q2.answer: Yes. A tip can go to the employee who served the customer, or be shared across the whole team, depending on your settings.

q3.question: Do I need any extra equipment?
q3.answer: No. A QR code at the counter, on the tables, or on an employee card is enough. delitip works alongside your existing setup, with no POS integration required.

q4.question: What happens with customer feedback?
q4.answer: Customers rate their experience and can leave a short note. Feedback appears on the same dashboard as tips and is tied to the employees who served the customers, so you find out their opinion early.

q5.question: How do I add my team members?
q5.answer: You can add your team through your business account. Each employee and manager has separate access, while tips and positive feedback are collected on their personal profile.

q6.question: Who processes the payments?
q6.answer: Payments are securely processed by Viva.com. Your business and team members never handle customers' card details.

footer.description: Digital tipping and customer feedback for businesses with customer-facing teams, from customer support offices to hotels and restaurants.

about.title: Great service deserves to be <accent>recognized</accent>
about.paragraphOne: At delitip, we want to make it easier for customers to reward the people who serve them. With a simple QR code scan, they can leave a tip and share their feedback.
about.paragraphTwo: We're building a simple, easy-to-use tipping and review solution for cafés, restaurants, hotels, and any business that wants to deliver a better customer experience. Employees receive the tips they earn, while businesses gain valuable insight into the quality of service they provide.
